rules.why: The kernel declares ocg-private-input@1 (OCG section 25, a caller-held salt), so its output depends on a value the replay does not hold. Excluded from the replay and counted.

Applies when reading a multi-machine report: mismatch evidence shaped like the async dispatch sentinel (an unawaited Promise serialized as an empty object). Classification only, it excludes nothing in a single replay.

Applies when reading a multi-machine report: the report carries the recipe marker and states same-machine reproduction through the canonical entry point. Classification only, it excludes nothing in a single replay.

Applies when reading a multi-machine report: every mismatching report passed the check that the stored fixture bytes hash to their own golden hash. Classification only, it excludes nothing in a single replay.
Same fixture and different live hash on two or more machines with no exclusion class, or mismatch evidence no rule explains. This is a determinism finding, never an exclusion.
